resources.string: Now open Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code. Keep that window open.
Pairing window found. Pull this notification down, tap \"Enter pairing code\" and type the 6-digit code.
Connected. FrameX now has shell access without Shizuku.
Paired, but could not connect yet. Make sure Wireless debugging is on, then press Connect in FrameX Settings.
Pairing failed. The code may be wrong or the pairing window was closed. Tap Pair again.
The code must be exactly 6 digits. Try again.
No pairing window found. Wireless debugging must be on and the phone must be on Wi-Fi. Tap Pair to try again.
